scientific_limits: Geometric agreement does not identify a unique phase or prove an HKL assignment.
Real-space HRTEM/ptychography FFT and SAED/kinematic electron diffraction do not share a general intensity-formation model.
Only projected reciprocal geometry is compared; exact lattice d-spacings use full simulated 3D reciprocal vectors.
Registration rotation comes from the separate fit-only proposal; this comparison stage does not fit or change experimental calibration.
Measurement snapshots retain their active-at-measurement calibration version; remeasure after later calibration correction/withdrawal.
Localization, calibration covariance and model uncertainty are not combined into an inferred statistical confidence.

scientific_limits: Only a proper in-plane rotation is estimated; scale, centre, screen reflection and distortion are not fitted.
Revise the explicit centre/scale and remeasure before making a new proposal; an old proposal is historical.
Held-out points and HKLs are distinct from fit evidence; this is geometric consistency, not statistical independence or unique phase identification.
Friedel mates and coincident projections are not admitted as independent held-out constraints.
The full comparison retains all ambiguities and unmatched reflections; fit residuals are not validation.
FFT and SAED do not share a general intensity-formation model; no intensity match or dynamical scattering is performed.

simulation_orientation.display_raster_relation: Same laboratory vectors; ASE/3Dmol use screen +Y up, pinned diffsims raster maps +Y to increasing rows. Compare scientific coordinates with explicit image-axis mapping, never silently mirror data.

simulation_orientation.in_plane_rotation_convention: active right-handed laboratory +Z; positive rotates +X toward +Y
simulation_orientation.index_convention: three-index direct lattice UVW; beam_cartesian = UVW @ row_vector_cell
